legend.label: 0–5°
legend.why_this_edge: below the 5° hazard-avoidance slope used for landing systems

legend.label: 5–10°
legend.why_this_edge: low to moderate slip expected on loose material (<10°)

legend.label: 10–15°
legend.why_this_edge: slip rises sharply on loose material (10–17°)

legend.label: 15–20°
legend.why_this_edge: upper end of slopes Apollo crews walked; near the 20° suit requirement

legend.label: 20–25°
legend.why_this_edge: at or above the 20° EVA suit requirement; near the Apollo rover design maximum (25°)

legend.label: 25–30°
legend.why_this_edge: above the Apollo rover design maximum; below the 30° Mars rover operating limit

legend.label: 30°+
legend.why_this_edge: above the 30° operating tilt limit of NASA Mars rovers

note: display only. Horn 3x3 slope at a 18 m baseline; each overlay pixel (20.9 m) shows the class of its nearest native pixel. Slope at a 18 m baseline is not comparable with slope at another baseline. Class edges are not danger thresholds. Transparent = no slope value.
